import sys

def ReFormatString(S, K):
    S = S.replace('-', '').upper()
    n = len(S)
    first_group_length = n % K or K
    result = [S[:first_group_length]]
    for i in range(first_group_length, n, K):
        result.append(S[i:i+K])
    return '-'.join(result)

input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
S = input[0]
K = int(input[1])
print(ReFormatString(S, K))
